I can help with the screen and the booking. First I need to verify your account. Could you give me your last name and the licence plate on the vehicle? I can't use the VIN for verification.

I also need to correct my colleague's earlier message. The Markham diagnosis times I can see are November 17 to 20, not November 26, and I can't confirm a same-day repair until a technician has looked at the screen. I can't offer a loaner or decide warranty coverage either. A warranty desk person handles that decision. Once you're verified, I can book one of the Markham times above for you.
